Graduate Programs
Graduate Programs
The Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering at Rowan University offers three graduate programs to provide students with advanced knowledge and skills necessary for a professional career or an academic position. Rowan CEE offers a MS in Civil & Environmental Engineering, a MS in Engineering Management, and a Ph.D. in Engineering with specialization in Civil Engineering. We ensure that graduate students master quantitative and interpretive skills in a specialized, chosen field for successful professional practice. The Ph.D. is conferred to outstanding students who can demonstrate the ability to conduct independent research and make substantial contributions to the advancement of their chosen field. Ph.D. students are required to make original contributions in Civil Engineering.
M.S. in Civil & Environmental Engineering
The Masters program accommodates both full & part time students. This results in a mix of students who have a combination of industry practice & research interests.
M.S. in Engineering Management
The science of Engineering Management bridges the gap between the technical world of engineering disciplines and the business world.
Ph.D. in Civil Engineering
The program prepares students to make original contributions to advance specialized areas of Civil Engineering.
Graduate Certificate Programs (COGS)
The CE Dept. is preparing for new certificate programs (COGS) in four areas of specialization.
Dr. Mohammad Jalayer serves as the graduate program coordinator for CEE.
Contact Information:
Office: Rowan Hall 234
Email: jalayer@rowan.edu
Phone: 856-256-5397
Our programs allows students to develop an interdisciplinary focus that is developed through their coursework and thesis topic. Graduate students have an opportunity to work in state of the art laboratory facilities and research centers. We offer the following specializations:
Structural Engineering
Environmental Engineering
Transportation Engineering
Geotechnical Engineering
Water Resources Engineering
Mechanics and Materials
Sustainability
Resiliency Planning for Communities
Students should consider pursuing graduate studies for the following reasons:
Specialization in a specific field of interest
Expanding skill sets
Career Advancement: Higher Salary; Job Security; Opportunities for upper level positions
Financial Aid
The Rowan Civil & Environmental Engineering Department offers financial aid to its graduate students in the form of teaching and research fellowships. These fellowships are available to Ph.D. students or Master's students in the thesis/research track and are highly competitive. Financial aid awarded due to fellowships vary, but may be available to cover the full cost of attendance with an additional stipend.
For additional inquiries, please contact Dr. Mohammad Jalayer at jalayer@rowan.edu.
